name: LedgerLab
description: Built-in benchmark for conservation across an Alice-to-Bob transfer.
objective: Click Reset demo state. Store the displayed Alice balance as 'before_sender'. Store the displayed Bob balance as 'before_recipient'. With Sender Alice and Recipient Bob, enter 100.00 in Amount (USD) and click Send transfer exactly once. Confirm the page displays Transfer completed. Store the displayed Alice balance as 'after_sender'. Store the displayed Bob balance as 'after_recipient'. Finish. Store the displayed currency text exactly.
